title: Introducing the Xometry Instant Pricing App for Onshape
summary: Access the power of the Xometry Instant Quoting Engine℠ directly within the Onshape platform based on your unique design. Get instant pricing, design feedback, and order custom parts directly within Onshape.
body_markdown:
We are excited to announce the launch of the **[Xometry Instant Pricing App](https://www.xometry.com/cad-add-in-for-onshape/)** for Onshape! You can now access the power of the Xometry Instant Quoting Engine℠ directly within Onshape.


This latest addition further expands our existing family of[add-ins](https://www.xometry.com/cad-add-ins/) for industry-leading CAD design software. The app is free to use and simple to implement. It gives you easy access to Xometry’s industry-leading pricing, design feedback, and lead time information directly in the Onshape environment.


The Xometry Instant Pricing App enables Onshape users to:


- Get instant pricing and lead times.
- Receive immediate design feedback on parts with its 3D viewer DFM feedback system.
- Choose from a wide range of processes, including 3D Printing, Sheet Metal, CNC Machining, and Urethane Casting.
- Choose from hundreds of material and finish combinations.
- One-click access to your Xometry quote on our platform to customize further and order your custom parts.


Rather than switching back and forth between platforms and various machine shops, you can streamline your work using one integrated workspace.[Click here](https://www.xometry.com/cad-add-in-for-onshape/) to learn more about how Onshape and Xometry can help you bring your visions to reality in a unified workspace.
